expansion_note: 4 fail-open cases (timeout/unreachable verifier treated as success, missing/empty/corrupt policy treated as no-restriction, truthy string-coercion flipping an authority flag open, swallowed exception inside a denylist/sanitizer returning unchecked value as pass). This historical expansion fixture is retained as provenance; every case and paired expectation is folded into the strict v0 corpus, so the strict v0 gate is the authoritative target.

cases.intent: A verification call wrapped in a timeout treats a timeout or transport error as success and proceeds, so when the verifier is slow or unreachable the gate it guards opens by default instead of failing closed.

A policy or allowlist config that is missing, empty, or fails to parse is treated as 'no restriction configured' and every request is permitted, so an absent or corrupt policy file opens the gate instead of refusing until a valid policy loads.

An authority flag is read with a truthy coercion of an external string, so values like 'false', '0', or 'no' coerce to true and flip a gate-skip or approval flag open; the parser is looser than the schema and a string input opens what should stay shut.

An exception while evaluating a denylist or sanitizer is caught and swallowed, and the code returns the un-sanitized or un-checked value as if the check had passed, so an error inside the safety check becomes an automatic allow.
